_note: Job advancement. 1st job = class (mastery at 10 after the Oath trial, skills at 13 and 16). 2nd job = branch picked at 20, skills at 20/25/30/35. 3rd job = unlocked by its trial at 40, skills at 40/48/56/64 (thirdSkills). 4th job = unlocked by the legendary trial at 70, skills at 70/80/90 and the ultimate at 100 (fourthSkills; the ultimate uses its own once-per-long-rest resource). Formulas: {p} is the hero's power level, {p/N} is max(1, floor(power/N)); mod is the primary ability modifier.
